title: Siena, Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 7: an orator at Milan to the Officials of the Balia, 1450s (unread)

steps.what: Found the whole busta Concistoro 2308 on DECODE (keys R4746-R4789, letters R4790-R4814, R1858) and downloaded the images with the project cookie (survey entry siena1421).
Indexed the 43 key records of fasc. 1 (1433 Petrucci, c. 1440 frate Bernardino and R4749, 1454 Milan ambassadors, Casole, 1478 Bichi, c. 1500 and 16th-c. keys).
No. 7 transcribed from the photographs by a subagent (agent J): 11 cipher lines, 363 tokens, 45 sign types, faint interlinear glosses over L04 and L08.

Key R4750 (Milan ambassadors 1454) tested sign by sign on the image (agent G): the L08 gloss contradicts it, 20% of the tokens are sign types R4750 lacks, its only e-sign is 2.5% of the text; an earlier 'milano' was a solver artefact, withdrawn.
Keys R4753, R4754, R4756, R4757, R4762 transcribed and tested against the L08 gloss: none fits.
The L08 gloss aligned with its signs: partial key 7=l, q=a, 6=n, +=o, B3=t, 2=e, x=r, 8o=i, c=o (homophonic: o has two signs).
Homophonic annealing (homsolve2) on the 363 tokens: no convergence.
Split out of the survey entry siena1421 under the one-key rule (George Lasry's report of 17 Oct 2026); its transcription moved to this folder; the report lists no. 7 as unsolved.
homsolve2.py with the nine gloss values fixed, it-cinquecento order 3-4, 12 restarts x 40,000 iterations: restarts disagree, best -2.04 per token, no Italian.
Compared no. 7 with the key of no. 8 (siena8, c. 1440-41, rebuilt from its contemporary decipherment): a different sign set.

outcome.method_basis: No filed key fits (R4750 contradicted by the letter's own gloss, five other keys fail it); homophonic annealing with the nine gloss values fixed does not converge on 363 tokens.
outcome.fraction_read_source: transcripts/no07.tok: no cipher token has a confirmed value beyond the gloss letters

gaps.detail: homophonic with at least 45 signs, no filed key fits, the gloss gives nine values

outcome.notes: George Lasry's report (17 Oct 2026) lists no. 7 as unsolved: c. 330 symbols, a few words with interlinear plaintext.

prior.where: Faint interlinear glosses on L04 and L08 of the letter itself (nine values).

human: Set the goal (decipher the letters of Concistoro 2308; try the filed keys first); passed on George Lasry's report of 17 Oct 2026 asking for one entry per key.
